content.comment_body: Hello, I tried updating the firmware for a [product_name] communication module by selecting the firmware update file path on my laptop and clicking 'LOAD.' During the process, the upload status reached 65%, but then I was automatically logged out of the web interface. After logging back in, I noticed a 'Format error' status. Please advise on what steps to take next. Screenshot is attached for reference. Thank you in advance.
If I were you, I'd initiate a support request.
After several attempts, I was able to update the firmware successfully.
Hello, I'm facing another issue now—I'm unable to save settings because the system asks for CA certificates. Where can I locate this certificate?

I managed to resolve the certificate warning by selecting STARTTLSIfAvail. However, I am now unable to send emails, though SMS works fine. In diagnostics, I see: 'Sending email failed. Last reply from server 535. Internal error identifier: 67. Number of attempts: 2.'
I've created a support request now. Thank you for the advice.
A new question published by [user_name] has been moved to its own thread titled 'What can do to receive the emails??'. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced several issues while updating firmware for a [product_name] communication module, encountering a 'Format error' during upload and difficulties with applying security certificates and configuring email notifications. The process was challenging, leading to repeated attempts and eventually requiring external support for resolution. Guidance for certificate handling and notification setup was unclear.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate a straightforward, well-guided firmware update procedure, explicit instructions regarding certificate requirements, and easy-to-configure email notifications.
